cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.text: Hi, Baba Muriel sent me to pick up something of Hilda's.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.source_cn: 你好，穆婆婆让我来找希尔达的旧物
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.male: Hi, Baba Muriel sent me to pick up something of Hilda's.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.female: Hi, Baba Muriel sent me to pick up something of Hilda's.

cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807003:.text: I don't think she can hear me.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807003:.male: I don't think she can hear me.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807003:.female: I don't think she can hear me.

say:6:1820808001:1.text: Go away! An outsider... traveling with a living person? You're not welcome here!
say:6:1820808001:1.source_cn: 滚出去！这里不欢迎你——外来的亡灵，还带着生者！

choice_prompt:7:1820808001.text: Go away! An outsider... traveling with a living person? You're not welcome here!
choice_prompt:7:1820808001.source_cn: 滚出去！这里不欢迎你——外来的亡灵，还带着生者！

say:8:1820808002:1.text: If you dare venture any further, I'll curse you—blinding your eyes and peeling your skin away, inch by inch!
say:8:1820808002:1.source_cn: 再敢往深处走，我就诅咒你们两个！你们的眼睛将变成两团浑...

say:9:1820808003:1.text: That's it? That curse of yours doesn't even hold a candle to the ones cast by the Bantus army.
say:9:1820808003:1.source_cn: 据我所知，班题斯军队的诅咒方式不会这么轻易。

choice_prompt:10:1820808003.text: That's it? That curse of yours doesn't even hold a candle to the ones cast by the Bantus army.
choice_prompt:10:1820808003.source_cn: 据我所知，班题斯军队的诅咒方式不会这么轻易。

say:11:1820808004:1.text: That's my warning! Leave this place at once!
say:11:1820808004:1.source_cn: 这是我的警告！马上离开这里！滚！

say:12:1820808005:1.text: With that, the hostile ghost passes through the barriers and disappears. Before she goes, she even makes sure to destroy your only path ahead.
say:12:1820808005:1.source_cn: 说罢，这个凶恶的幽灵穿透障碍，消失在你们二人面前。离开...
say:12:1820808005:1.male: With that, the hostile ghost passes through the barriers and disappears. Before she goes, she even makes sure to destroy your only path ahead.
say:12:1820808005:1.female: With that, the hostile ghost passes through the barriers and disappears. Before she goes, she even makes sure to destroy your only path ahead.

say:13:1820808006:1.text: She won't listen to reason, and my sword can't touch her.
say:13:1820808006:1.source_cn: 她完全无法交流，我的剑也不能对她造成伤害。
say:13:1820808006:1.male: She won't listen to reason, and my sword can't touch her.
say:13:1820808006:1.female: She won't listen to reason, and my sword can't touch her.

say:14:1820808007:1.text: We'll have to <style="highlight">find another way through</style>. Let's get what Baba Muriel needs and get out of here. I'd rather not deal with that ghost again.
say:14:1820808007:1.male: We'll have to <style="highlight">find another way through</style>. Let's get what Baba Muriel needs and get out of here. I'd rather not deal with that ghost again.
say:14:1820808007:1.female: We'll have to <style="highlight">find another way through</style>. Let's get what Baba Muriel needs and get out of here. I'd rather not deal with that ghost again.

choice:10:0:1.text: Curses usually do things far worse than that.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 任何魔法诅咒都没有这么简单
choice:10:0:1.male: Curses usually do things far worse than that.
choice:10:0:1.female: Curses usually do things far worse than that.

choice:10:1:2.text: You're just lashing out, aren't you?
choice:10:1:2.male: You're just lashing out, aren't you?
choice:10:1:2.female: You're just lashing out, aren't you?

narration:16:18020815:0.text: You attempt to speak with Bessie, but she ignores you. Suddenly, a ghost attacks. Thane draws his blade, but it passes harmlessly through the spirit.
narration:16:18020815:0.source_cn: 你们试图与蓓丝安交流，但她毫无反应。此时一个幽灵突然冒...

narration:16:18020815:0.female: You attempt to speak with Bessie, but she ignores you. Suddenly, a ghost attacks. Thane draws his blade, but it passes harmlessly through the spirit.
